description: This file defines API endpoints for managing 'model' resources in a web application using FastAPI. It includes routes for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and exporting models, with interactions delegated to a storage service.

methods.name: dict list_models()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all saved models, returning their summaries.

methods.name: GraphModel get_model( model_id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the model to retrieve."), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific model by id.

methods.name: create_or_update_model(payload: GraphModelCreate)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update (upsert) a model.

methods.name: update_model( payload: GraphModel, model_id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the model to update."), )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing model by id.

methods.name: delete_model( model_id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the model to delete."), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a model by id.

methods.name: export_model( model_id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the model to export."), format: Literal["png"] = "png", )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export a model (not implemented in MVP).

ctags.name: export_model
ctags.signature: ( model_id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the model to export."), format: Literal["png"] = "png", )
